z-m-24-01.title: Umgca omnye wesisombululo ucime isisombululo
z-m-24-01.topic: Izisombululo ezinyamalala xa omabini amacala e-equation ahlulwa libinzana elifanayo
z-m-24-01.goal: Fumana ukuba ngowuphi umgca wesisombululo apho isisombululo sanyamalala khona, ubhekisele jikelele imiqathango yee-equation apho oku kwenzeka khona, yenza ii-equation zakho ezilahlekelwa sisisombululo uze uchaze isizathu.
z-m-24-01.material: U-Jia wasombulula i-equation x³ = 4x wabhala "izisombululo zi-2 kunye ne-−2, ezimbini". U-Doyun wajonga isisombululo sika-Jia wathi kuphela sasihluke kwimpendulo yakhe, ngaphandle kokunika isizathu. Kulo msebenzi, zonke ii-x ngamanani anyanisekileyo. (x³ ifundwa "x ikyubhu" kwaye x² ifundwa "x isikwere".)
z-m-24-01.thinking.1: Ukugweba imiqathango apho ukuguqula ibinzana kutshintsha iseti yezisombululo
z-m-24-01.thinking.2: Ukwenza imizekelo echasayo (ii-equation ezilahlekelwa sisisombululo) wena
z-m-24-01.prereq.0: I-H2 kule bhetshi ngumahluko wobunzima nenqanaba lenkxaso kwaye ayithethi ibanga elifundiswa esikolweni. Ucwangciso lwesikolo olucingelweyo: ufunde kwisikolo samabanga aphakathi indlela yokusombulula ii-equation ze-quadratic ngokwenza iifaktha, kwaye wadibana nokwenza iifaktha zamabinzana e-cubic kwiMathematika eQhelekileyo.
z-m-24-01.prereq.1: Indlela yokufaka ixabiso kwi-equation ukujonga ukuba omabini amacala alingana na
z-m-24-01.prereq.2: Zonke ii-x kulo msebenzi ngamanani anyanisekileyo.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.prompt: Esi sisisombululo sika-Jia. Khetha umgca owenze isisombululo singalunganga, okanye umgca apho loo mpazamo ibonakala njengoko injalo.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kumgca ngamnye, jonga enye enye "ingaba yi-equation enezisombululo ezifanayo nomgca owandulelayo?"
z-m-24-01.s.s1.hint.1: Faka i-0, 2, −2 kwi-x ngokulandelelana ujonge ukuba i-equation yokuqala x³ = 4x iyasebenza.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.line.1: Ukwahlula omabini amacala nge-x kunika i-x² = 4.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.line.4: Ngoko izisombululo zale equation zi-2 kunye ne-−2, ezimbini.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.explain: Kumgca 2 sahlula nge-x, kodwa ukuba ufaka x = 0 kwi-equation yokuqala, omabini amacala angu-0, ngoko iyasebenza. Imeko x = 0 ayizange ijongwe ngokwahlukileyo, ngoko isisombululo 0 saphoswa, kwaye eso siphumo sakhokelela kwi-"ezimbini" kumgca 5. Imigca 3 no-4 isombulule ngokuchanekileyo i-equation emva kokwahlula. Izisombululo ezinyanisekileyo ze-equation yokuqala zintathu, −2, 0, 2.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.prompt: Zonke ii-equation ezingezantsi zisonjululwe phezu kwamanani anyanisekileyo. Yeyiphi engalahlekelwa nasisiphi na isisombululo se-equation yokuqala nokuba wahlula omabini amacala ngebinzana elinikwe kwiibraket okanye kwinkcazelo uze usombulule kuphela i-equation esalayo?
z-m-24-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kwi-equation nganye, jonga ukuba ikho na ixabiso le-x elenza ibinzana ofuna ukwahlula ngalo libe ngu-0.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.hint.1: Faka amaxabiso owafumeneyo kumacala omabini e-equation yokuqala, uze ujonge nokuba ikho na i-equation engenanani elinjalo lokwenyani kwaphela.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.a: Lolu khetho olungazange lujonge ukuba kwenzeka ntoni emacaleni omabini xa ufaka ixabiso elenza x − 2 ibe ngu-0 kwi-equation yokuqala.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.b: Uphosile ukuba ixabiso elenza umhluli abe ngu-0 linokuba sisisombululo se-equation yokuqala. Faka x = 0.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.c: Lolu khetho olusebenze ngokusebenzisa njengomgangatho ukuba ikho na inani lokwenyani elenza umhluli abe ngu-0.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.d: Nokuba kukho isikwere, kwixabiso apho x − 1 ingu-0, omabini amacala angu-0. Jonga ukuba elo xabiso lisisisombululo na.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.explain: Ukuba omabini amacala anemilo f·g = f·h, ixabiso apho f ingu-0 lihlala lisisisombululo. Ngoko ukuba likho inani lokwenyani apho f ingu-0, kufuneka ulinyamekele ixabiso elo ngokwahlukileyo phambi kokwahlula. x² + 3 ingu-3 ubuncinane kuyo nayiphi na inani lokwenyani, ngoko ayingu-0 naphakade, kwaye kwi-c awulahlekelwa sisisombululo (x = 4) ngokwahlula. Ukuba uluhlu lwandiswa kumanani apheleleyo, izisombululo ze-x² + 3 = 0 kufuneka ziqwalaselwe nazo, ngoko imeko iyahluka.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.prompt: Yenza ii-equation ezi-3 ezahlukileyo zemilo (x − a)(x − b) = c(x − a). a, b, c ngamanani apheleleyo ukusuka kwi-−9 ukuya kwi-9 kwaye c ≠ 0. Yenza isisombululo esahlula omabini amacala nge-x − a silahlekelwe sisisombululo esinye, nesisombululo esilahlekileyo a singesonegethivu kwaye isisombululo b + c esifunyenwe emva kokwahlula sipositive.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ukhethe a ibe negethivu, uze uzame ukutshintsha b no-c ukuze b + c ibe ipositive.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.hint.1: Jonga ukuba kwenzeka ntoni xa ufaka x = a kumacala omabini e-equation oyenzileyo.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.ok.c2: Onke amanani omathathu asuka kwi-−9 ukuya kwi-9.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.ok.c5: Isisombululo b + c esifunyenwe emva kokwahlula sipositive.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.explain: Umzekelo, ukuba a = −3, b = 1, c = 2, ngoko (x + 3)(x − 1) = 2(x + 3). Ukwahlula nge-x + 3 kunika kuphela x = 3, kodwa x = −3 nayo yenza omabini amacala abe ngu-0, ngoko sisisombululo. Ukuhambisa yonke into kwicala elinye kunika (x + 3)(x − 3) = 0, ngoko izisombululo zimbini, −3 kunye no-3. Ii-equation apho isisombululo a nesisombululo b + c esifunyenwe emva kokwahlula zifanayo zibalwa njengenye, ngoko ukuba ezi zimbini zahlukile, ziyi-equation ezahlukileyo.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.prompt: Khetha enye yee-equation owazenzileyo ubhale ukuba sesiphi isisombululo (ngamanani) esinyamalala xa omabini amacala ahlulwa nge-x − a, nesizathu.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.hint.0: Bala ukuba icala ngalinye liba yintoni xa ufaka x = a kwi-equation oyenzileyo.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.hint.1: Thelekisa cala ngecala isisombululo esifunyenwe ngebinzana emva kokwahlula nesisombululo esifunyenwe ngokuhambisa yonke into kwicala elinye.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ujonge ngamanani akumzekelo wakho ukuba ukufaka isisombululo esinyamalalayo kwi-equation yokuqala kwenza omabini amacala alingane?
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ubhale isizathu esithi "ixabiso elenza umhluli abe ngu-0" ngamazwi akho?
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ucinge ubuncinane ngendlela enye yokufumana zonke izisombululo ngaphandle kokwahlula (umzekelo, ukuhambisa yonke into kwicala elinye uyenze ibe yimveliso)?
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.model.0: Ibinzana endilenzileyo yi-(x+3)(x−1)=2(x+3). Ukuba ndahlula nge-x+3, kusala kuphela x=3, kodwa ukuba ndifaka x=−3, omabini amacala angu-0, ngoko u-−3 sisisombululo nawo. Lixabiso elenza umhluli abe ngu-0, ngoko isisombululo siyalahleka.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.model.1: Kwi-(x+1)(x−4)=−1(x+1), ukwahlula nge-x+1 kunika kuphela x−4=−1, oko kukuthi, x=3. Kodwa ukuba x=−1, x+1 ingu-0 kwaye omabini amacala ayalingana, ngoko u-−1 sisisombululo nawo, kwaye unyamalala kuba kufana nokwahlula nge-0.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.modelNote.1: Kulungile nokuthi iqale yathi isisombululo esifunyenwe emva kokwahlula yaza yathi isisombululo esinyamalalayo.

z-m-24-02.title: Ingxaki engenaluhlu inazo izisombululo ezingaphi?
z-m-24-02.topic: Inani lezisombululo ze-equation ye-cubic x³ = 1 noluhlu lwamanani
z-m-24-02.goal: Sebenza ukuba isisombululo sicinga luluphi uluhlu lwamanani, gcina okanye uhlaziye isigqibo sakho malunga nenani lezisombululo ngalo lonke ixesha ulwazi olutsha lufika, uze uqinisekise ngempendulo exhomekeke kuluhlu nangezisombululo ozifumana wena.
z-m-24-02.material: Kukho ingxaki yokufumana izisombululo ze-equation x³ = 1. Uluhlu lwe-x alubhalwanga engxakini. U-Minsu wabhala isisombululo esithelekisa ubukhulu, kwaye u-Seoyun, owabona isisombululo, wabuza, "Akufuneki siqale sigqibe uluhlu?" Ulwazi luvezwa ngecandelo elinye ngexesha, ngoko gqiba isigqibo sakho ngalo lonke ixesha. (x³ ifundwa "x ikyubhu".)
z-m-24-02.thinking.0: Ukuthi uluhlu (umqathango) apho impikiswano isebenza khona
z-m-24-02.thinking.1: Ukuhlaziya okanye ukugcina isigqibo ngolwazi olutsha
z-m-24-02.prereq.0: I-H2 kule bhetshi ngumahluko wobunzima nenqanaba lenkxaso kwaye ayithethi ibanga elifundiswa esikolweni. Ucwangciso lwesikolo olucingelweyo: sele ufundile kwiMathematika eQhelekileyo intsingiselo yamanani apheleleyo (iyunithi engeyonyani i, i² = −1) nokuphindaphinda kwawo, i-discriminant yee-equation ze-quadratic, nokwenza iifaktha zamabinzana e-cubic.
z-m-24-02.prereq.1: Umqathango wokuba amanani amabini apheleleyo alingane: iinxalenye ezinyanisekileyo ziyalingana, kwaye iinxalenye ezingeyonyani ziyalingana.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa ngecandelo elinye ngexesha. Ngalo lonke ixesha, khetha isigqibo ujonge ukuba ulwazi olutsha luyatshintsha okanye luyagcina isigqibo.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ngalo lonke ixesha ulwazi olutsha luvela, phinda ufunde ukhetho owalwenza ngaphambili ubhale ngomgca omnye oko kutshintshileyo.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.hint.1: Phambi kokukhetha inketho, qala ujonge "luluphi uluhlu lwamanani" ukhetho olo olucingayo.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Le yingxaki yokusombulula i-equation x³ = 1. Uluhlu lwe-x alubhalwanga engxakini. Isisombululo sika-Minsu: "x = 1 sisisombululo. Ukuba x > 1 ngoko x³ > 1, kwaye ukuba x < 1 ngoko x³ < 1, ngoko isisombululo esiyedwa yi-x = 1." ('>' ifundwa "likhulu kune" kwaye '<' ifundwa "lincinci kune".)
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukuba x linani lokwenyani, impikiswano ka-Minsu ilunge (ukuba likhulu kune-1, x³ > 1, kwaye ukuba lincinci, x³ < 1). Kodwa uluhlu alubhalwanga, ngoko asikwazi okwangoku ukuba ukucinga ngamanani anyanisekileyo kuphela kuyanela na.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Onke amanani anokuthelekiswa ngobukhulu, ngoko isisombululo sika-Minsu silunge kwaye isisombululo esiyedwa yi-1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Awucingisisanga ukuba onke amanani anokulandelelaniswa njengamakhulu nancinci na. Cinga ukuba ngawaphi amanani anokuthelekiswa ngobukhulu.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Isisombululo silunge xa x linani lokwenyani. Kodwa akukho luhlu, ngoko kufuneka ukujonga ngakumbi
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ufunde ukuba isisombululo sicinga ngawaphi amanani, wabandakanya nasesigqibweni sakho ukuba uluhlu alukho.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: I-equation ye-cubic kufuneka ibe nezisombululo ezintathu, ngoko isisombululo esithi kukho enye asilunganga
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uqinisekise inani lezisombululo ngebanga kuphela. Zingaphi izisombululo ezahlukileyo kufuneka zijongwe ngokujonga ibinzana noluhlu.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ufake kuphela x = 1, ngoko akukho nto inokwaziwa kwesi sisombululo
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Isisombululo sinenxalenye ecinga iimeko ezikhulu kune-1 nezincinci kune-1 nayo. Funda oko eqinisekisa kona loo nxalenye.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Kuvele iinxalenye ezimbini zolwazi olutsha. (1) x³ − 1 = (x − 1)(x² + x + 1), kwaye i-discriminant ye-equation ye-quadratic x² + x + 1 = 0 yi-1 − 4 = −3. (2) Inkcazelo ekuqaleni kwale ncwadi yengxaki ithi "kule yunithi, ii-equation zisonjululwa kumanani apheleleyo", kodwa le ngxaki ngokwayo isengenaluhlu.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Ukusuka kwi-x − 1 = 0 kuphuma isisombululo sokwenyani i-1, kwaye x² + x + 1 = 0 inediscriminant enegethivu, ngoko ayinazisombululo zokwenyani kwaye inezisombululo ezimbini ezahlukileyo ezingeyonyani. Ukuba lokwenyani, isisombululo esi-1; ukuba ngamanani apheleleyo, izisombululo ezi-3. Ekubeni uluhlu lungamiselwanga, zombini ukuphendula ngoluhlu, okanye ukubhala ingcamango esekelwe kwinkcazelo yeyunithi uphendule u-3, zinengqiqo. Isigqibo sika-Minsu "kumanani anyanisekileyo kukho isisombululo esi-1" sihlala sinjalo.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ingxaki ayinaluhlu, ngoko cinga kuphela ngamanani anyanisekileyo uphendule kuphela ukuba isisombululo yi-1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ilunge njengempendulo koluhlu lwamanani anyanisekileyo, kodwa awusebenzisanga ulwazi olutsha, ukubala kwe-discriminant nenkcazelo yeyunithi, kwisigqibo sakho.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: I-discriminant yi-−3, enegethivu, ngoko le equation ayinazisombululo kuyo nayiphi na uluhlu lwamanani
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: I-discriminant yinkcazelo malunga nefaktha enye x² + x + 1. Ulibele ukuba kukho enye ifaktha, x − 1.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Phendula ngokwahlula uluhlu: isisombululo esi-1 ukuba kunyanisekile, izisombululo ezi-3 ukuba ngamanani apheleleyo
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ufake inyaniso yokuba uluhlu alumiselwanga kwimpendulo njengoko injalo. Esi sigqibo sibonisa ukuba impendulo ixhomekeke kwimiqathango.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ulandela inkcazelo yeyunithi, yithathe njengamanani apheleleyo ubhale u-3, ngelixa uthi ingcamango
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Usebenzise ingcebiso yenkcazelo yeyunithi wathi ingcamango. Esi sigqibo sibhale zombini isiseko nomda.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Biza ingcambu enye engeyonyani ω = (−1 + √3 i)/2. (i yiyunithi engeyonyani kunye ne-i² = −1, kwaye ibinzana lifundwa "ukususa 1 kongeza ingcambu ye-3 i, ngaphezulu kwe-2".) Siyazi ukuba ω yingcambu ye-x² + x + 1 = 0. Sifuna ukujonga ngqo ukuba le ω ngokwenene iyanelisa x³ = 1 nayo.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ziziphi iindlela zokujonga ezivumelekileyo? (Zinokuba ziindlela ezininzi.)
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Zombini iindlela ziyajonga ngokuchanekileyo. a isebenzisa kuphela ω² + ω + 1 = 0, kwaye c ifumana ω² ngqo iphindaphinde. Ixabiso eliqikelelwayo (b) yinkcazelo nje ebamba iimpazamo zokubala hayi ukuqinisekisa, kwaye d icinga isigqibo kwangaphambili. Ekubeni ingcambu engeyonyani nayo yanelisa x³ = 1 ngolu hlobo, isigqibo sangaphambili sokuba kukho izisombululo ezi-3 kumanani apheleleyo siyaxhaswa.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Sebenzisa ω² = −ω − 1 ukubala ω³ = ω·ω² = −ω² − ω = 1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ukhethe indlela yokwehlisa ω³ ibe libinzana elilungeleyo le-ω usebenzisa ibinzana oselaziwa.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Bhala ω njenge-−0.5 + 0.87i, uphindaphinde amaxesha amaninzi, kwaye uthathe njengejongiwe ukuba isondele kwi-1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ukubala ngamaxabiso aqikelelweyo kuncedisa njengophicotho, kodwa akuqinisekisi ukuba yi-1 kanye.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Fumana ω² uyiphindaphinde nge-ω ukujonga ukuba (−1+√3 i)(−1−√3 i)/4 = 1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ukhethe indlela yokujonga ngokuphindaphinda ngqo. Isitshixo kukuba inxalenye engeyonyani inyamalala njani.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ekubeni ω yingcambu ye-equation ethile, thatha ω³ = 1 njengesele isebenza uyisebenzise njengoko injalo
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Uthathe isigqibo ofuna ukusijonga njengesele sisebenza. I-equation apho ω yingcambu yi-x² + x + 1 = 0, hayi x³ = 1.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.reflect: Ukuba ekuqaleni wacinga "isisombululo esiyedwa yi-1", ngoluphi ulwazi olwanciphisa isigqibo esi lwaba "silunge kumanani anyanisekileyo"? Kutheni impikiswano ethelekisa ubukhulu ingasetyenziswa kumanani angeyonyani?
z-m-24-02.s.s2.prompt: Cinga ukuba inani eliphelele z = a + bi (a, b ngamanani anyanisekileyo) lanelisa z³ = 1. Ekubeni (a + bi)³ = (a³ − 3ab²) + (3a²b − b³)i, inxalenye enyanisekileyo a³ − 3ab² kufuneka ibe yi-1 kwaye inxalenye engeyonyani 3a²b − b³ kufuneka ibe yi-0. Faka izisombululo ezi-3 ezahlukileyo njenge-(a, b). Amanani angenangqiqo angabhalwa aqukuqelwe kwiindawo ezimbini zedesimali, kwaye impazamo engaphakathi kwe-0.02 iyamkelwa.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.hint.0: Jonga ukuba x³ − 1 iba yintoni xa ufaka z = 1, uze ufumane izingcambu zebinzana le-quadratic elisalayo x² + x + 1.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.hint.1: Beka inxalenye enyanisekileyo yengcambu oyifumeneyo kwi-a nenani elingaphambi kwe-i kwi-b, uze ubale ukuba amabinzana amabini asondele kwi-1 nakwi-0, ngokulandelelana.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Inxalenye enyanisekileyo ihambelana ne-1 (ngaphakathi kwempazamo ye-0.02).
z-m-24-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Inxalenye enyanisekileyo a³ − 3ab² ye-(a + bi)³ ayiyi-1.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Inxalenye engeyonyani ihambelana ne-0 (ngaphakathi kwempazamo ye-0.02).
z-m-24-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Inxalenye engeyonyani 3a²b − b³ ye-(a + bi)³ ayiyi-0.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.explain: Izisombululo zintathu, z = 1, z = (−1 + √3 i)/2, z = (−1 − √3 i)/2. Njengeedesimali zimalunga ne-(1, 0), (−0.5, 0.87), (−0.5, −0.87). Isisombululo esifanayo esibhalwe ngamanani ahlukileyo emva kwedesimali asibalwa njengesisombululo esahlukileyo. Isisombululo esiyedwa esinenxalenye engeyonyani engu-0 yi-1, kwaye ngokuthelekisa ubukhulu kuphela awunakufumana ezinye izisombululo ezimbini.
